10, 9, 6, 5 (HJ)
Two terrible games in a row. I should give up.

Lauren 10, Tom 9, Christine 8, Seth ~6. I took a risk and started on a port, but with excellent ore production. Very slow start but then cranked up bigtime. Also had a wood port with decent production there. Little bit of brick; absolutely no wheat/sheep. Raced Seth to three different build spots and edged out every time so he was in bad shape. Christine had massive sheep production and a sheep port, and with everyone focusing robber/soldier on me I though this was hers. But somehow with fairly unimpressive production and a lot of seemingly wasted builds, Lauren quietly snuck in for the win -- taking both largest army and longest road (I had a chance to snag it but I was so hemmed in that evaporated on me), and successfully fishing for a VP card. I'd have likely won on the next roll, but them's the breaks. Very close and a lot of fun.
Second place in a three-player game on BGA (10-7-6).
